name: Jerson Caibog
title: Software Engineer
summary: Software Engineer with hands-on experience designing and delivering end-to-end web applications. Skilled in architecture, scalable system design, and frontend-to-backend integration, with expertise in database modeling, API development, and performance optimization. Proven ability to build production-ready, maintainable solutions and collaborate across cross-functional teams to deliver impactful, user-centric products.

highlights.label: Architecture
highlights.text: Built and shipped a multi-tenant platform running 8 production deployments (4 public streamer sites, 4 admin panels) from one Turborepo codebase and database, with a shared typed API layer of 65+ functions.

highlights.label: Database & Security
highlights.text: Designed an 18-table Postgres schema with row-level security enforcing admin/editor roles at the database layer, plus a full audit log of staff actions and 2FA-secured staff invitations.

highlights.label: Admin Suite
highlights.text: Delivered 10 admin screens covering affiliate offer management with drag-and-drop ranking, giveaway and raffle lifecycles through winner selection, bulk media management, taxonomy, menus, and SEO controls.

highlights.label: Fraud Prevention & Analytics
highlights.text: Flagged duplicate giveaway entries by shared IP and device fingerprint, enforced one entry per account in the database, and built a click-through analytics dashboard with server-rendered SVG sparklines, with no charting dependency.

highlights.label: Build
highlights.text: Built and maintain a 53-page marketing site (25 service pages, blog, portfolio, careers) across 439 components, in a pnpm workspace with the CMS Studio.

highlights.label: CMS
highlights.text: Designed 17 Sanity schema types so marketing edits page copy, SEO metadata, blog posts, and job listings without a developer, including reusable referenced CTA blocks.

highlights.label: Performance
highlights.text: Implemented Cloudflare edge image resizing with generated srcset ladders, route-scoped CMS queries, and a deferred cookie-consent bundle, cutting Total Blocking Time by ~300ms.

highlights.label: Technical SEO
highlights.text: Own JSON-LD structured data, a sitemap generated from live routes and CMS content, breadcrumbs, and 301 redirects, working to an external SEO agency's audits. Also shipped a Turnstile-protected contact flow and a D3/TopoJSON global-presence map.

experience.blurb: Design and ship full-stack web applications end to end, from database schema and APIs to frontend and deployment. Remote, Netherlands.

highlights.label: API & Tools
highlights.text: Integrated Cal.com and other APIs for seamless scheduling and data flow.

highlights.label: Full-stack Delivery
highlights.text: Developed client platforms (VerzendNL, Lumatask) with React.js, Next.js, Tailwind CSS from architecture to deployment.

highlights.label: Collaboration
highlights.text: Worked in Agile teams with designers and QA; implemented CI/CD and version control strategies.

experience.blurb: Built client web apps with React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS, integrated third-party APIs, and worked in an Agile team with designers and QA.

highlights.label: System Design
highlights.text: Built full-stack Student Council Management System for ~6,000 students, handling users, events, attendance, and fines.

highlights.label: Frontend
highlights.text: Developed UI with React.js, Tailwind CSS, React Query, and React Hook Form, using reusable and modular components for scalable interfaces.

highlights.label: Database
highlights.text: Designed PostgreSQL schema with optimized indexing, normalized relationships, and efficient queries across all entities.

highlights.label: Security
highlights.text: Implemented JWT authentication with role-based access control (RBAC) in Node.js/Express.js.

highlights.label: Automation & Performance
highlights.text: Automated fine calculations and server-state synchronization; reduced administrative workload by 80–90%.

highlights.label: Machine Learning & Computer Vision
highlights.text: Real-time detection of customizable hand gestures using OpenCV and TensorFlow for touchless smart home control.

highlights.label: IoT Hardware
highlights.text: Controlled appliances, lighting, and security via ESP32/ESP32-CAM and relay modules with low-latency offline performance.

highlights.label: Full-Stack Dashboard
highlights.text: Built responsive web interface with React.js, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, and WebSockets for live streaming, monitoring, and manual overrides.

highlights.label: Impact & Accessibility
highlights.text: Supported user-defined gestures for accessibility and achieved SUS 92.83 (Grade A) with excellent benchmark ratings.

work.name: Effectzorg recruitment site
work.title: Effectzorg — healthcare recruitment site
work.summary: Careers site for a Dutch healthcare recruitment agency, with radius-based vacancy search and ATS-linked applications.

points.label: Module system
points.text: Each folder in modules/ with block.json, module.php and fields.php self-registers via one auto-loader. Field groups live in code, so deploys need no DB import.

points.label: Location search
points.text: Vacancy search filters by Haversine distance over a REST endpoint and returns server-rendered cards. Typed locations geocode server-side, cached hourly.

points.label: Build pipeline
points.text: Tailwind v4 compiles through Vite, and the compiled stylesheet is committed because the production host has no Node, so builds happen before push.

points.label: Saved jobs
points.text: Visitors save vacancies to localStorage with no account. A JS card builder mirrors the PHP one so saved and live listings render identically.
